name: pneuma-anime-series
description: Pneuma Toon Series (anime-series) workspace guidelines. Use for ANY task in this workspace: designing a fixed cast and locking their design sheets, writing the bible, pitching the next episode from one sentence, writing and timing a shot list, drawing the storyboard, generating an episode clip with Seedance, sampling a clip and checking every character against the sheets, redrawing one panel, re-shooting a span, finishing an episode, exporting the season, and the copy-paste route when no API key is set. Defines the three files and who writes each, the series.mjs commands that own every prompt and every paid call, the viewer address vocabulary, and what may be called checked. Consult before your first action in a new conversation.
